basic.name: What Are You Looking At?
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Herta's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: One-Time Offer
skill.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Herta's ATK to all enemies. If the enemy's HP percentage is 50% or higher, DMG dealt to this target increases by 20%.

ultimate.name: It's Magic, I Added Some Magic
ultimate.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Fine, I'll Do It Myself
talent.description_template: When an ally's attack causes an enemy's HP percentage to fall to 50% or lower, Herta will launch a Follow-Up ATK, dealing Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

technique.name: It Can Still Be Optimized
technique.description: After using her Technique, Herta's ATK increases by 40% for 3 turn(s) at the beginning of the next battle.

2.name: Efficiency
2.description: When Skill is used, the DMG Boost effect on target enemies increases by an extra 25%.

4.name: Puppet
4.description: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 35%.

6.name: Icing
6.description: When Ultimate is used, deals 20% more DMG to Frozen enemies.

eidolons.name: Kick You When You're Down
eidolons.description: When using Basic ATK, if the designated enemy's HP percentage is at 50% or less, additionally deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 40% of Herta's ATK.

eidolons.name: Keep the Ball Rolling
eidolons.description: Every time Talent is triggered, this character's CRIT Rate increases by 3%. This effect can stack up to 5 time(s).

eidolons.name: That's the Kind of Girl I Am
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Hit Where It Hurts
eidolons.description: When Talent is triggered, DMG increases by 10%.

eidolons.name: Cuss Big or Cuss Nothing
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: No One Can Betray Me
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate, this character's ATK increases by 25% for 1 turn(s).
